session_6.text: Yep, we sure showed those Hassidic jewellers a thing or two about softball..

session_6.speaker: Chloe
session_6.text: Can I ask you guys a question? D'you ever think that Alan is maybe.. sometimes..

session_6.speaker: Ariel
session_6.text: Well, no. That's impossible. You can never be too Alan.

session_6.speaker: Bennett
session_6.text: Yeah, it's his, uh, innate Alan-ness that-that-that we adore.

session_6.speaker: Dexter
session_6.text: I personally could have a gallon of Alan.

session_10.speaker: Bennett
session_10.text: A thumb?!

session_10.speaker: All
session_10.text: Eww!

session_10.speaker: Fiona
session_10.text: I know! I know, I opened it up and there it was, just floating in there, like this tiny little hitch-hiker!

session_10.speaker: Dexter
session_10.text: Well, maybe it's a contest, y'know? Like, collect all five?

session_10.speaker: Fiona
session_10.text: Does, um, anyone wanna see?

session_10.speaker: All
session_10.text: Nooo!

session_10.speaker: All
session_10.text: Oh, hey, don't do that! Cut it out!

session_10.speaker: Ariel
session_10.text: It's worse than the thumb!

session_10.speaker: Dexter
session_10.text: Hey, this is so unfair!

session_10.speaker: Chloe
session_10.text: Oh, why is it unfair?

session_10.speaker: Dexter
session_10.text: So I have a flaw! Big deal! Like Ethan's constant knuckle-cracking isn't annoying? And Bennett, with his over-pronouncing every single word? And Chloe, with that snort when she laughs? I mean, what the hell is that thing? ...I accept all those flaws, why can't you accept me for this?

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: ...Does the knuckle-cracking bother everybody?

session_10.speaker: Ariel
session_10.text: Well, I-I could live without it.

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Well, is it, like, a little annoying, or is it like when Fiona chews her hair?

session_10.speaker: Bennett
session_10.text: Oh, now, don't listen to him, Pheebs, I think it's endearing.

session_10.speaker: Ethan
session_10.text: Oh,  "you do, do you"?

session_10.speaker: Bennett
session_10.text: You know, there's nothing wrong with speaking correctly.

session_10.speaker: Ariel
session_10.text: "Indeed there isn't"... I should really get back to work.

session_10.speaker: Fiona
session_10.text: Yeah, 'cause otherwise someone might get what they actually ordered.

session_10.speaker: Ariel
session_10.text: Ohh-ho-hooohhh. The hair comes out, and the gloves come on.

session_12.speaker: Ethan
session_12.text: Do you have any respect for your body?

session_12.speaker: Bennett
session_12.text: Don't you realise what you're-you're doing to yourself?

session_12.speaker: Dexter
session_12.text: Hey, y'know, I have had it with you guys and your cancer and your emphysema and your heart disease. The bottom line is, smoking is cool, and you know it.

session_12.speaker: Ariel
session_12.text: Dexter? It's Alan, he wants to speak to you.

session_12.speaker: Dexter
session_12.text: Really? He does?  Hey, buddy, what's up! Oh, she told you about that, huh. Well, yeah, I have one now and then. Well, yeah, now. Well, it's not that big- ..well, that's true,.. Gee, y'know, no-one- no-one's ever put it like that before. Well, okay, thanks!

session_12.speaker: Bennett
session_12.text: If only he were a woman.

session_13.speaker: Dexter
session_13.text: Ooh, Lambchop. How old is that sock? If I had a sock on my hand for thirty years it'd be talking too.

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Okay. I think it's time to change somebody's nicotine patch.

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Hey. Where's Ethan?

session_13.speaker: Dexter
session_13.text: Ethan ate my last stick of gum, so I killed him. Do you think that was wrong?

session_13.speaker: Ariel
session_13.text: I think he's across the hall.

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Thanks.

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: There y'go.

session_13.speaker: Dexter
session_13.text: Ooh, I'm alive with pleasure now.

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Hey Pheebs, you gonna have the rest of that Pop-Tart?.. Pheebs?

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: Does anyone want the rest of this Pop-Tart?

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Hey, I might!

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: Sorry. ..Y'know, those stupid soda people gave me seven thousand dollars for the thumb.

session_13.speaker: All
session_13.text: You're kidding. Oh my God.

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: And on my way over here, I stepped in gum. ...What is up with the universe?!

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: What's going on?

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Nothing. I just think it's nice when we're all here together.

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear..

session_13.speaker: Ariel
session_13.text: Uh, Ethan..

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Oh, God!

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Okay..

session_13.speaker: All
session_13.text: Oh! That was Lambchop!

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Please, guys, we have to talk.

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: Wait, wait, I'm getting a deja vu...no, I'm not.

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Alright, we have to talk.

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: There it is!

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Okay. It's-it's about Alan. There's something that you should know. I mean, there's really no easy way to say this.. uh.. I've decided to break up with Alan.

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Is there somebody else?

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: No, nononono.. it's just.. things change. People change.

session_13.speaker: Ariel
session_13.text: We didn't change..

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: So that's it? It's over? Just like that?

session_13.speaker: Fiona
session_13.text: You know.. you let your guard down, you start to really care about someone, and I just- I-

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Look, I- I could go on pretending-

session_13.speaker: Ethan
session_13.text: Okay!

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: -but that wouldn't be fair to me, it wouldn't be fair to Alan- It wouldn't be fair to you!

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Who-who wants fair? Y'know, I just want things back. Y'know, the way they were.

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: I'm sorry..

session_13.speaker: Dexter
session_13.text: Oh, she's sorry! I feel better!

session_13.speaker: Ariel
session_13.text: I just can't believe this! I mean, with the holidays coming up- I wanted him to meet my family-

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: I'll meet somone else. There'll be other Alans.

session_13.speaker: All
session_13.text: Oh, yeah! Right!

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: Are you guys gonna be okay?

session_13.speaker: Bennett
session_13.text: Hey hey, we'll be fine. We're just gonna need a little time.

session_13.speaker: Chloe
session_13.text: I understand.

session_15.speaker: Ariel
session_15.text: Remember when we went to Central Park and rented boats?.. That was fun.

session_15.speaker: Bennett
session_15.text: Yeah. He could row like a viking.

session_15.speaker: Chloe
session_15.text: He said he's really gonna miss you guys.

session_15.speaker: Bennett
session_15.text: You had a rough day, huh.. c'mere.

session_15.speaker: Dexter
session_15.text: I don't care, I don't care! Game's over! I'm weak! I've gotta smoke! I've gotta have the smoke!

session_15.speaker: Fiona
session_15.text: If you never smoke again I'll give you seven thousand dollars!
